doc: The weapons the player gets. Moves and damage rules are Dark Souls III's. The first build repurposes an existing Dark Souls III weapon row (same moveset, same numbers) and gives it Space Marine 2's sounds and, through the item text, its name; Space Marine 2's models and numbers are a later upgrade (milestone 5). The bolt pistol is Avelyn because it is the base-game crossbow that fires a burst of three bolts per trigger pull (the Light Crossbow it started from fires one and then reloads).

ds3_weapon_class.doc: which Dark Souls III weapon supplies the moveset

model_source.doc: later upgrade (milestone 5); empty while the first build uses the Dark Souls III model

stats_source.doc: later upgrade (milestone 5); empty while the first build uses the Dark Souls III numbers

ds3_base_row.doc: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST row id of the Dark Souls III weapon that is repurposed (checked against the game's own table by the probe)

ds3_base_name.doc: that row's name in Dark Souls III (English); the item-text file (msg/ENGLISH/item.msgbnd.dcx) is overridden so the player sees display_name instead

ammo_row.doc: ranged weapons: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST row id of the ammunition (a stack whose count falls when the weapon fires)
